💨 Fart Simulator 💨

Welcome to Fart Simulator, a lighthearted cartoon simulator where you can earn Fart leaderstat points, climb the leaderboard, and explore fun islands 🌴

Earn Farts to unlock new zones, buy titles, and discover floating worlds high in the sky! The more you collect, the faster you progress. This game focuses on silly, non-realistic humor and classic simulator gameplay.

✨ Features

Collect Farts to grow stronger

Unlock zones with higher requirements

Upgrade stats for faster progress

Explore islands, castles, and campsites

Simple, fun, simulator-style gameplay

Remember to follow Roblox TOS. Any rule violations should be reported in the group, Draft Order.

Can you become the ultimate collector? 🚀
